verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes concrete ESP32 supply-decoupling placement criteria: move the 0.1 µF capacitor within 2 mm of the 3V3 pin while allowing the 10 µF bulk capacitor to remain in place.

The client unambiguously accepts retaining the existing ESP32 decoupling-capacitor placement after the freelancer's target-specific explanation; replay overwrites the prior local-placement criterion without leaving a stale key.
